note.slideDescription1: Create concise knowledge cards with Markdown syntax support
note.slideDescription2: Wrap content with {{}} syntax to mask key content that needs to be memorized
note.slideDescription3: Click the button in reading mode or flashcard mode to toggle the display effect

wiki.slideDescription1: Connect knowledge points together with bidirectional references and inline references for easy access
wiki.slideDescription2: Select the reference option from the menu, choose the note to reference, and create a bidirectional reference
wiki.slideDescription3: Wrap another note's title with [[]] syntax, click to jump to the corresponding note

flashcard.slideDescription1: Archived notes and notes not yet due will not appear in the study queue.
flashcard.slideDescription2: Recall the masked content and assess your mastery. The system will automatically optimize the next review time based on your input.
flashcard.slideDescription3: Color indicators provide an intuitive overview of your current mastery level.
flashcard.slideDescription4: Colour indicators provide an intuitive overview of your current mastery level.

quiz.slideDescription1: By default, quizzes include recently untested notes, or can be set to all notes. Image notes are currently not supported
quiz.slideDescription2: Intelligently selects question types based on your note content and quiz style, including single choice, multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, and more
quiz.slideDescription3: You can actively regenerate the current quiz or skip the current question. The system will automatically optimize the difficulty of the next quiz
quiz.slideDescription4: After completing the quiz, you can view the results and review notes related to incorrect answers

sync.slideDescription1: After signing in, your notes automatically sync to the server when updated
sync.slideDescription2: After modifying notes on other devices, you can manually sync on this device or wait for auto-sync

share.slideDescription1: Notes synced to the cloud can be quickly shared with others using the share feature

cloud.slideDescription1: Unlock massive cloud note capacity for access, sharing, and backup anywhere, anytime
cloud.slideDescription2: Integrated with the world's most advanced generative language models to enhance your learning journey
cloud.slideDescription3: Support for images, documents, and various formats to create complete, engaging notes

curated.slideDescription1: Curated collections feature quality notes carefully selected by Noolingo users, organized by topic for easy discovery
curated.slideDescription2: Click any collection to preview note content, then download to your notebook with one tap
curated.slideDescription3: Enable sharing in notebook settings and generate a share code. Your quality notes may appear in curated collections to help more learners

sampleDescription: Start with these examples to build your knowledge base

review.title: Study Mode
review.description: Rate your recall - the system schedules your next review automatically

mastery.title: Progress
mastery.description: Colors show how well you know each note - updated with every study session

imageMask.slideDescription1: Insert images in notes, supporting multiple image formats
imageMask.slideDescription2: Draw mask areas on images to hide key information that needs to be memorized
imageMask.slideDescription3: In reading or study mode, mask areas are hidden to help you actively recall
